sources.title: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF: Lightweight Open-Source LLM
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF is a 1.5 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, distributed in GGUF format for efficient local inference. It supports 32K token context with 8K generation, handles 29+ languages, and is optimized for coding, mathematics, and structured output generation. The model is open-source under Apache 2.0 license ...
